commands.name: /pr
commands.description: Create or update a GitHub Pull Request from the current branch using gh, with a templated body.

arguments.name: body
arguments.description: PR body (supports markdown). If omitted, generates from git diff.

arguments.name: base
arguments.description: Base branch to merge into (default: main).

commands.name: /commit
commands.description: Create a conventional commit with a multi-line message via heredoc and show status.

commands.name: /review
commands.description: Summarize current diff and highlight risks, test gaps, and CI considerations.

commands.name: /e2e
commands.description: Run end-to-end integration tests via scripts/test-e2e.sh (all|backend|frontend|combined).

commands.name: /ci-latest
commands.description: Show latest GitHub Actions runs for the current branch and their statuses.

script.content:
set -euo pipefail; command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'gh is required for /ci-latest'; exit 1; }; BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD);
 gh run list --branch "$BRANCH" --limit 5 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,displayTitle,createdAt,url --jq '.[] | {id: .databaseId, status: .status, conclusion: .conclusion, title: .displayTitle, created: .createdAt, url: .url}'

commands.name: /pr-ready
commands.description: Push current branch and ensure it has an open PR; print PR URL and CI runs.

arguments.name: title
arguments.description: PR title if a PR needs creating.

commands.name: /pr-checks
commands.description: Watch PR checks for the current branch.

script.content: set -euo pipefail; command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'gh is required for /pr-checks'; exit 1; }; if gh pr view >/dev/null 2>&1; then gh pr checks --watch || gh pr checks; else echo 'No open PR for current branch'; fi

commands.name: /k8s-context
commands.description: Show current kubectl context and available namespaces.

script.content: set -euo pipefail; command -v kubectl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'kubectl is required for /k8s-context'; exit 1; }; kubectl config current-context; echo; kubectl get ns --no-headers | awk '{print $1}' | head -n 20

commands.name: /k8s-deploy
commands.description: Apply Kubernetes manifests from k8s/manifests (or a provided path).

commands.name: /k8s-restart
commands.description: Restart a Kubernetes deployment (kubectl rollout restart).

script.content:
set -euo pipefail; command -v kubectl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'kubectl is required for /k8s-restart'; exit 1; }; DEP="$1"; NS="${2-}"; if [ -n "$NS" ]; then NS_OPT="-n $NS"; else NS_OPT=; fi;
kubectl rollout restart deployment/"$DEP" $NS_OPT; kubectl rollout status deployment/"$DEP" $NS_OPT

commands.name: /k8s-logs
commands.description: Tail logs for a deployment's pods (last 200 lines, follow).

commands.name: /db-migrate
commands.description: Run Diesel database migrations against DATABASE_URL (backend).

script.content: set -euo pipefail; command -v diesel >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'diesel CLI is required for /db-migrate'; exit 1; }; DB="${1-${DATABASE_URL-}}"; cd backend; if [ -n "$DB" ]; then diesel migration run --database-url="$DB"; else diesel migration run; fi

commands.name: /docker-logs
commands.description: Tail logs for a local Docker container (last 200 lines, follow).

script.content: set -euo pipefail; command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'docker is required for /docker-logs'; exit 1; }; docker logs --tail=200 -f "$1"

commands.name: /workflow-audit
commands.description: Audit .github/workflows for common issues: missing triggers, empty steps, naming.

commands.name: /deploy
commands.description: Run repo deploy script if available (scripts/deploy/deploy.sh).

script.content: set -euo pipefail; if [ -x scripts/deploy/deploy.sh ]; then scripts/deploy/deploy.sh; else echo 'scripts/deploy/deploy.sh not found'; exit 1; fi
